svg.title: Adam carries the 0.01 scale deeper than plain descent
svg.desc: Two panels of bands, one row per number of hidden layers and initial scale, 0.01 in grey and He in blue, on an axis of the loss at epoch 500 from 0 to 1.15 with a dashed line at ln 3 = 1.0986; each band spans five seeds with one tick per seed, and two columns give the runs that went below a loss of 1.0 and the first epoch below 1.0. Plain gradient descent at learning rate 1.0: 1 hidden, 0.01: 1.0713, 1.0535, 1.0629, 1.0635, 1.0431, 0 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 none; 1 hidden, He: 1.0237, 1.0405, 1.0556, 1.0604, 1.0279, 0 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 none; 2 hidden, 0.01: 1.0946, 1.0745, 1.0819, 1.0769, 1.0816, 0 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 none; 2 hidden, He: 0.5505, 0.5276, 0.5651, 0.5755, 0.4205, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 77 to 133; 3 hidden, 0.01: 1.0986, 1.0986, 1.0986, 1.0986, 1.0986, 0 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 none; 3 hidden, He: 0.4888, 0.3843, 0.5887, 0.4388, 0.3769, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 45 to 62. Adam at learning rate 0.02: 2 hidden, 0.01: 0.1409, 0.1189, 0.1691, 0.1550, 0.2032, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 30 to 40; 2 hidden, He: 0.0640, 0.0558, 0.0704, 0.0575, 0.0251, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 24 to 37; 4 hidden, 0.01: 0.3098, 0.0513, 0.1661, 0.1029, 0.1013, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 50 to 104; 4 hidden, He: 0.0525, 0.0189, 0.0420, 0.0215, 0.0144, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 18 to 25; 5 hidden, 0.01: 0.4696, 0.1717, 0.2180, 0.0956, 1.0986, 4 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 65 to 117; 5 hidden, He: 0.0238, 0.0470, 0.0253, 0.0351, 0.0121, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 15 to 25; 6 hidden, 0.01: 1.0986, 1.0986, 1.0986, 0.2011, 0.1120, 2 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 186 to 191; 6 hidden, He: 0.0938, 0.0512, 0.0415, 0.0978, 0.0111, 5 of 5 below 1.0, first epoch below 1.0 15 to 27.
svg.text: Adam carries the 0.01 scale deeper than plain descent
Loss at epoch 500 on the spiral, 64 neurons per hidden layer with ReLU; seeds 0 to 4 for each row.
Under plain descent 0.01 has not left ln 3 at three hidden layers; under Adam it loses runs from five.
